direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden; 48px header, 40px compact horizontal rail, minmax(0,1fr) main, 56px action bar; enlarged cinematic factory SVG fills at least 70% of main with independent reserved zones for callouts, stations and jobs, no overlap; all targets at least 36px; skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, then action bar in tab order
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald and brushed silver only: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22), silver #C5CCD4, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68), emerald #A8F04A with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text only; official logo immutable in black, emerald and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body, no label under 12px; large header tabs spanning most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow along feasible emerald routes, state glow, depth cues and cinematic 240ms transitions driven by real state change; 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; prefers-reduced-motion removes flow, glow pulses and transitions so silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene with bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar with Back left, status centre, one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens typed consent form; pending task proposal deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and approved recovery plan may coexist while replacement tasks await approval; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald with living material flow, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning gap inside stage bounds; depth and state glow reinforce hierarchy; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; full-shop cascade represents every machine with department depth and affected-operation state

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene to at least 70% of main and give callouts, stations and jobs independent reserved zones so the discrepancy tracks sit inside the scene without crowding.
Raise side-zone body copy to 16px/24 and keep the second official logo placement in the opening story at native aspect, black, emerald and brushed silver.
Add living emerald material-flow emphasis only on feasible routes and a soft state glow on RECEIVING hold, with reduced-motion fallback to pattern and text.
Separate connection readiness for provider identity from the investigation evidence task with distinct headings, status lines and controls; do not merge their actions.
Enlarge header tab labels to at least 16px and ensure the compact horizontal rail targets remain equal-width, non-wrapping and keyboard movable with arrow keys.
Trim narration in the side zone to one instruction and one status sentence at 16px body type.
Make the three recovery paths visually linked to the factory SVG: selecting or focusing a path highlights its feasible route with emerald flow and glow.
Increase tradeoff metrics to 26px tabular type and keep Select controls at least 36px tall with a clear 2px emerald focus ring.
Reserve a fixed decision-status zone so No acceptance recorded does not shift layout when selection changes.
Keep the typed consent form prominent after selection: enlarge the exact-phrase field to 16px, show match progress, and keep Accept disabled until exact with aria-live polite feedback.
Synchronise the selected Split available capacity card in the scene with the consent panel using emerald outline and state glow, static under reduced motion.
Move the plan identifier into a muted silver micro-label so the typing instruction remains the dominant line.
Clarify the pending proposal state: keep 3 PROPOSED and UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL visually distinct from tracked work with dashed silver borders and emerald only on the current task.
Add depth and a subtle emerald glow to task t1 while t2 and t3 stay dimmed, preserving the Ready, After t1, After t2 sequence at 16px.
Align the three station cards and three job cards on one grid rhythm to lift cinematic polish within 1366x768.
Strengthen the preview: CELL-MILL-2 already uses silver cross-hatching; add a cross marker and plain OFFLINE preview wording, and animate the 24h to 0h change only when motion is allowed.
Keep the invalidating-action status centred in the action bar at 16px so Apply second shock consequence is unmistakable.
Show emerald flow rerouting through CELL-MILL-1 in the preview while no route passes through the stopped cell.
Retain silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text on CELL-MILL-2, and remove any route through it; feasible emerald flow should visibly stop at that boundary.
Keep connection readiness separate from the Reinvestigate recovery evidence task, with the sample offline status stated once in each zone.
Make the CELL-MILL-2 OFFLINE banner a persistent callout in a reserved zone linked bidirectionally with the SVG node.
Render the constrained Split path with silver cross-hatching and plain text explanation inside its reserved card, never relying on colour alone.
Highlight Use verified substitute as the selected feasible path with emerald route flow toward JOB-1001 and JOB-1002 totalling 70 units.
Keep the revised typed consent block in a fixed-height zone so the disabled Accept control and typed count never shift the scene.

Preserve coexistence clearly: label 3 BLOCKED prior tasks and 3 PROPOSED replacements as separate groups, with replacements untracked until approval and the approved revised plan stated in the action bar.
Give the blocked group silver hatching and the proposed group dashed emerald-silver borders so state is readable without colour alone.
Enlarge the task pager targets and add focus ring visibility for keyboard stepping through tasks 1 to 3.
Make the 01 Verify, 02 Seal, 03 Retain sequence cinematic with depth and emerald glow only on the active READY stage, locked stages in dim silver.
Raise proof side-zone body copy to 16px and separate Verify ledger, Seal packet and Retain checkpoint into fixed reserved zones with distinct status lines.
Add a restrained cinematic transition when Verify completes, removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

Represent every machine in the full-shop cascade with consistent isometric depth, but ensure OFFLINE uses silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text on each stopped machine rather than icon-only meaning.
Refit the department grid to fill the 1366x768 viewport without the empty lower-right void; enlarge cards and metrics while keeping all seven departments visible.
Add emerald living flow only on feasible recovery routes between departments and a persistent legend, with glow and flow removed under reduced motion.

Score judge impact explicitly in presentation: lead with the certificate discrepancy, human typed consent, second shock and proof chain in that order, with the official logo in the opening story as the second required placement.
Enlarge pitch type to at least 16px body and make the full-shop cascade image the hero visual showing every machine and affected-operation state.
Cut narration to one claim per section so impact, control and evidence read in a single pass.
